Hi all —

I ran the numbers and attached an updated pricing calculator and a short cost breakdown PDF. High level:

Assumptions used:
- Model: rwd-13b-standard (hosted) and rwd-13b-quant (optimized, 4-bit)
- Avg tokens per request: 400 (prompt + response)
- 50M tokens = pilot; 200M = scale scenario

Per-1M token unit economics (rounded):
- Hosted Standard (rwd-13b-standard): $120 / 1M tokens
- Hosted Optimized (rwd-13b-quant): $80 / 1M tokens
- Dedicated Reserved (commit 250M/mo): $60 / 1M tokens (requires 12-mo commit; includes minor support add-on)

Invoice-style estimates:
- Pilot (50M tokens):
  * Hosted Standard = 50 * $120 = $6,000 / month
  * Hosted Optimized = 50 * $80 = $4,000 / month
  * Dedicated (pro-rated at 50M from 250M commit pricing) = 50 * $60 = $3,000 / month

- Scale (200M tokens):
  * Hosted Standard = 200 * $120 = $24,000 / month
  * Hosted Optimized = 200 * $80 = $16,000 / month
  * Dedicated (250M commit pricing applied) = 200 * $60 = $12,000 / month

Target budget math: to hit $10k/month at 50M tokens requires a unit rate of $200 / 1M tokens (10,000 / 50 = 200). We are well below that on our standard and optimized options — hosted optimized and dedicated options fall into Acme's pilot budget band.

Attachments included: acme_pricing_calculator_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes line-item model + infra + support breakdown; acme_cost_breakdown.pdf (PDF) — one-page invoice estimate and notes on commit terms.

Notes / tradeoffs:
- Dedicated (commit) gives the best unit rate but requires a longer-term commitment and procurement approvals.
- Hosted optimized offers a lower near-term cost with no commit, good for pilots.
- We can also propose a short-term trial credit for the first month to lower immediate procurement friction.

Next steps: Sean — if this looks good I can produce a formal invoice PDF and a simple SOW draft for procurement. Tom/Alice — any preference on which scenario you want formalized?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Pricing & Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
